notes: Sheet is drawn rotated (page top is roughly west): McMicken runs down the middle, Vernon along the top, Renner down the right side, Hamburg across the middle, North Elm (printed N. ELM (NOT IMPROVED)) along the bottom. Names printed without suffix (VERNON, MOHAWK, RENNER, HAMBURG, STARK, BRANCH, DUNLAP) written with 'Street'; NAGEL ALLEY as printed. Mohawk Street is labelled MOHAWK south of Hamburg; the same 40' street runs north to Vernon and off the top (Mohawk Street of sheet 228). It narrows to ~18 ft and then ~28 ft south of block 5 before reaching North Elm (bends). Crossings on this sheet's boundary streets are picked here even where they also appear on picked neighbours: Branch/Stark, Stark/Dunlap and Dunlap/McMicken (also 218, where Stark/Dunlap is at (4334,1887) and Dunlap/McMicken at (4641,173)), North Elm/McMicken and North Elm/Renner (also 219), Vernon/McMicken, Vernon/Mohawk, Vernon/Renner, Mohawk Place/McMicken and Nagel Alley/McMicken (also on my sheet 228). Central Av/Bank St in the top-left margin is not picked (217/227/228 have it). The street printed BRANCH here (30', from Stark west to x~1090, where it turns SW) is the unnamed '?' 30 ft street on sheet 218; 218's 'Branch Street' is the SW leg. The strip along the canal's SE bank is printed only PLUM here; it is written East Plum Street because it is the continuation of 218's East Plum Street (east bank of the Miami Canal). North of the tip of block 4 (2080,1790) it merges with Stark Street and runs NNE (house nos. 2026-2032) to Mohawk Place at the east end of Mohawk Bridge: Stark ends at it (T where the Stark centreline meets the Plum centreline) and Plum ends at Mohawk Place. Plum runs SW off the sheet edge at about (200,4900) toward 218. Mohawk Place (62' near the bridge, 65' near McMicken) runs from Mohawk Bridge SE to McMicken; the McMicken junction is a wide open area, point where the Mohawk Pl axis (which the 10 in. pipe follows) meets the McMicken centreline. Stark (50') runs south to Dunlap and ends there; Dunlap (40') runs from the SW edge NE past Stark to McMicken and ends there. Renner jogs twice (bends). Hamburg (50') ends at McMicken on the west and crosses Mohawk and Renner, running off toward 230. The unnamed 12' alley runs from Vernon across Hamburg to the block 6 lot line (alleys); no name is printed on it, so it is not recorded as an intersection. Miami Canal, tow path, Foot Bridge, Central Av (top left), railroad and brewery passages ignored.
